description: Rail Length (km) At End-of-Year is a dataset listed in Singapore open data portal (data.gov.sg), an open data portal, published or maintained by Land Transport Authority. The MRT network was extended to link Yishun and Chua Chu Kang with the Woodlands Extension in 1996. Bukit Panjang LRT started operation in 1999. Changi Airport Line commenced operation in 2002. North East Line (NEL) and Sengkang LRT opened for service in 2003. Punggol LRT opened for service in Jan 2005. Coverage: Singapore. The portal files it under the publisher Land Transport Authority. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-06-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sg-dgs-portal.
